manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Prossh from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{R}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
Prossh triggers, creating a number of 0/1 Kobolds of Kher Keep and 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens equal to the amount of mana spent to cast Prossh.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Prossh and two Kobold and/or Squirrel tokens, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Choose to return Prossh to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Kobold or Squirrel, adding {1}.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast Prossh.
Repeat from step 1.
